description.value:
Requirements You control an overclocked minion.

When you apply the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Conceal Spell] spellshape to a spell, you can manifest the spell from one of your overclocked minions instead of yourself. Use the minion's space to determine the spell's source, range, and area of effect, but line of sight and line of effect must be met from both you and your minion when the spell is cast. If the spell has a range of touch, you can have the minion deliver the spell to a creature within its reach.
